source_title: Conservation of Ramsey's theorem for pairs and well-foundedness

standard_prerequisites.name: The finite-level proposition of this section
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a countable topped model of RCA_0 plus the scheme at level n minus one, every colouring and every auxiliary set above the jump of Y, there is a homogeneous set preserving the scheme at level n and controlling the jump; retained with this card at source lines 1506-1514.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted corollary is exactly this proposition with the auxiliary set supplied internally, so the statement must be available to see what is dropped.

standard_prerequisites.name: Omega-extension for finite levels of induction and collection
standard_prerequisites.statement: Every countable topped model of RCA_0-star plus the scheme at level n minus one can be omega-extended into a model of the same theory plus weak Konig's lemma, a result attributed to Harrington, Simpson-Smith and Hajek and recorded by Belanger; the citation is carried in the proof and its entry is attached with this card.
standard_prerequisites.use: It replaces the external auxiliary set of the proposition by a set P obtained inside the model, which is the only new ingredient of the corollary.

standard_prerequisites.name: RCA_0-star and the jump of the topped model
standard_prerequisites.statement: RCA_0-star is the fragment of RCA_0 in which the extension step above is stated, and the model extended by its own jump satisfies that fragment at level n minus one because the scheme is assumed for the original model.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof applies the extension result to the model extended by its jump, which is why the corollary needs no external auxiliary set.

core_obligations: Apply the omega-extension result to the model extended by its own jump, which satisfies the fragment of the base theory plus the scheme at level n minus one, to obtain a set P above the jump of Y whose model satisfies the same theory plus weak Konig's lemma (source line 1549).
Apply the proposition of this section to the model, the colouring and that set P, obtaining a homogeneous set G with the model of G satisfying the scheme at level n (source line 1552).

Read off the two asserted properties of the counted corollary: the homogeneity and infiniteness of G, and satisfaction of the base theory plus the scheme at level n in the model of G, noting that the jump control asserted by the proposition is not part of the corollary (source lines 1544-1545).

proof_roadmap.step: Produce the internal auxiliary set P by omega-extension of the model extended by its jump.
Apply the finite-level proposition and drop its jump-control clause to get the corollary.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2402.11616v3 的 Corollary cor:rt22-sig2（源 1540-1547 行，证明 1548-1553 行）：把有限层版本的保持结果从「带外部辅助集与跳跃控制」简化为「不带辅助集、不控跳跃」。证明只有两步，但都不是例行核验：第一步必须把 ω-扩张结果用在「模型加自身跳跃」上（正因为假设了原模型满足 T_n，才有 M[Y'] ⊨ RCA_0*+T_{n-1}），从而在模型内部造出辅助集 P（1549 行）；第二步把上一张命题的三个前提逐一对上并明确**丢掉跳跃控制那一款**，才得到所宣称的两条性质（1552 行）。难点在于「外部辅助集」如何被内部取得，以及结论要恰好只保留两条性质；原文位置在证明的 1549 与 1552 行。

editorial_notes: The counted unit is the article's own Corollary cor:rt22-sig2 at source lines 1540-1547 together with the proof environment that begins on the next line (1548-1553); the pairing is the ordinary adjacent one.

The retained context is the statement of Proposition prop:rt22-sig2 at source lines 1506-1514, which the proof applies; that proposition is counted by a sibling card of this lane and the counted intervals are disjoint.

The counted proof carries the author citation of Belanger. The entry is supplied as a task-directory fragment holding it exactly as the bibtex run had formatted it, because the bibtex backend cannot be used here: the harness runs both xelatex passes before bibtex, so a generated bbl is never read back and the citation would stay undefined in the final pass.
The author has left a commented-out alternative first step at source lines 1550-1551; it is commented out and is not author text for our purposes, and it is not retained.

The retained preamble reproduces verbatim the author's document class at source line 2, his theorem declarations at source lines 16-25, his macro definitions at source lines 46-88 and 91, and his natural-operation macros at source lines 104-107, and it retains mathabx and cleveref; the stix-dependent LS2 block and the inputenc load with the utf8x option are not retained.
